[CameraHelper](./three-story-controls.camerahelper.md)


</td><td>

A helper tool for creating camera animation paths and/or choosing camera look-at positions for points of interest in a scene

<tr><td>

[CameraRig](./three-story-controls.camerarig.md)


</td><td>

The CameraRig holds the camera, and can respond to [CameraAction](./three-story-controls.cameraaction.md)<!-- -->s such as Pan/Tilt/Dolly etc. It can also be controlled along a given path (in the form of an `AnimationClip`<!-- -->), or tweened to specified points.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[Damper](./three-story-controls.damper.md)


</td><td>

Damper uses simple linear damping for a given collection of values. On every call to update, the damper will approach a given set of target values.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[FreeMovementControls](./three-story-controls.freemovementcontrols.md)


</td><td>

Control scheme to move the camera with arrow/WASD keys and mouse wheel; and rotate the camera with click-and-drag events.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[KeyboardAdaptor](./three-story-controls.keyboardadaptor.md)


</td><td>

Parse keyboard events and emit either dampened values for continuous keypresses, or trigger events named according to a provided keymapping.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[PathPointsControls](./three-story-controls.pathpointscontrols.md)


</td><td>

Control scheme to transition the camera between specific points (frames) along a path specified through an `AnimationClip`<!-- -->.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[PointerAdaptor](./three-story-controls.pointeradaptor.md)


</td><td>

Parse pointer events to emit dampened, normalized coordinates along with the pointer count (for detecting multi-touch or drag events)


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[ScrollAdaptor](./three-story-controls.scrolladaptor.md)


</td><td>

Emits normalized values for the amount a given DOM element has been scrolled through.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[ScrollControls](./three-story-controls.scrollcontrols.md)


</td><td>

Control scheme to scrub through the CameraRig's `AnimationClip` based on the scroll of a DOM Element


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[StoryPointsControls](./three-story-controls.storypointscontrols.md)


</td><td>

Control scheme to transition the camera between given points in world space.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[SwipeAdaptor](./three-story-controls.swipeadaptor.md)


</td><td>

Emits events in response to swipe gestures above a given threshold.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[ThreeDOFControls](./three-story-controls.threedofcontrols.md)


</td><td>

Control scheme for slight rotation and translation movement in response to mouse movements (designed to be used in conjunction with other control schemes)


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[WheelAdaptor](./three-story-controls.wheeladaptor.md)


</td><td>

Parse mouse wheel events and emit either dampened values, or trigger events for swipes that cross a given threshold.
